dct_creator_sm: Szczyrba, Laura (Queen's University, Queen's University. Department of Geological Sciences and Geological Engineering). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8558-7335
dct_description_sm:
SWASH (Simulating Waves 'til SHore) input, command, and processed output files for all storm events (J, M1, M2) and idealized simulations including: bathymetry, directional spectrum, command files, and processed output files ("Proc_" files).
Radar data for J, M1, and M2 also provided alongside processed radar data.
Data required to generate all related figures also provided ("FigX_" files).
dct_title_s: Nearshore Flow Dynamics -- SWASH and XBand Radar
